title: Law to require yearly reporting on domestic violence hotline calls
summary: This bill would require the Mayor's Office to End Domestic and Gender-Based Violence to publish an annual report on its survivor hotline. The report, broken down by month, would cover calls received, answered and abandoned, wait times, use of interpretation services, referrals made and the borough where calls originated. The report would be due to the Mayor and Council Speaker no later than January 31 each year.
